title: Ender Scythe
description: Its add a ender scythe that teleports behind people.
body: Dont question about the name of the file its normal mod, this file name is from poland and its mean custom weapons but there is just one weapon that is insanely opbut to craft it you must have burnt ender pearl, one netherite sword, two netherites, two blaze rods one chorus flower and two soul sands.
